source_sha.definition: sha256(raw file bytes).hexdigest()[:12]  (or deterministic aggregate over a directory's tracked source files)
source_sha.git_blob_hash_definition: sha1('blob ' + len(content) + '\0' + content)  [or sha256 variant with same header convention]
source_sha.confirmed_incompatible_format: source_sha is 12 hex chars (truncated sha256); git hash-object output observed elsewhere in repo (surface_check_cli.py) is 40 hex chars (sha1) -- visibly different formats
source_sha.consumer_compares: index-time local hash vs current-read-time local hash (both working-tree, not committed state)
source_sha.adaptation_note: algorithm is git-independent; comparing source_sha to sha256(git show <ref>:<path>) would work, but nothing in the estate does this
